died.name: Michael Servetus
died.cause: while being burned at the stake for heresy on a pyre of his own books
died.last_words: Jesus, Son of the eternal God, have mercy on me!

died.name: Akbar
died.cause: to his nobles and his son, Jahangir; he then asked their forgiveness if he had ever wronged them
died.last_words: I cannot bear that any misunderstanding should subsist between you and those who have for so many years shared in my toils and been the companions of my glory.

died.name: Jack Youll
died.cause: prior to being killed in action at the Battle of Vittorio Veneto during World War I
died.last_words: It's all right Cowling; we've got them stone cold.

died.name: Tony Morabito
died.cause: to the priest who gave him final absolution

born.name: James Cook
born.desc: British explorer and Royal Navy captain
born.cause: after being mortally wounded by a native Hawaiian

born.name: Theodore Roosevelt
born.desc: president of the United States and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: to family servant James E. Amos
born.last_words: Please put out that light, James.

born.name: Fritz Sauckel
born.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
born.last_words: I am dying innocent. The sentence is wrong. God protect Germany and make Germany great again. Long live Germany! God protect my family.
